title: Divorce, the Rich Young Man, and True Greatness

questions.question: When the Pharisees asked Jesus if it is lawful for a man to divorce his wife, He asked what Moses commanded them. They said Moses allowed a man to write a certificate of divorce and to send her away. According to Jesus, why did Moses write this?
options: "Because of your hardness of heart he wrote you this commandment."
"Because Moses knew the nature of women was difficult."
"Because it was revealed to Moses on Mount Sinai."
"Because God wishes no one to suffer an unhappy marriage."
questions.correctAnswer: "Because of your hardness of heart he wrote you this commandment."
questions.explanation: Mark 10:5 (ESV): "And Jesus said to them, 'Because of your hardness of heart he wrote you this commandment.'"

questions.question: Jesus appealed to the original creation regarding marriage, ending with: "What therefore God has joined together, let not man..."?
options: "...separate."
"...judge."
"...destroy."
"...forsake."
questions.explanation: Mark 10:9 (ESV): "What therefore God has joined together, let not man separate."

questions.question: When people brought children to Jesus and the disciples rebuked them, Jesus was indignant and said what?
options: "Let the children come to me; do not hinder them, for to such belongs the kingdom of God."
"Unless they be quiet, the kingdom of God is far from them."
"The children must be educated in the synagogue first."
"Bring them when they are older to understand the cross."
questions.correctAnswer: "Let the children come to me; do not hinder them, for to such belongs the kingdom of God."
questions.explanation: Mark 10:14 (ESV): "But when Jesus saw it, he was indignant and said to them, 'Let the children come to me; do not hinder them, for to such belongs the kingdom of God.'"

questions.question: Jesus took the children in His arms and did what to them?
options: He blessed them, laying his hands on them
He fed them with bread and fish
He baptized them in the river
He instructed them strictly in the Law
questions.correctAnswer: He blessed them, laying his hands on them
questions.explanation: Mark 10:16 (ESV): "And he took them in his arms and blessed them, laying his hands on them."

questions.question: A man ran up, knelt before Jesus, and asked, "Good Teacher, what must I do to inherit eternal life?" Jesus told him to keep the commandments. What did the man claim?
options: "Teacher, all these I have kept from my youth."
"Teacher, I have tried, but failed many times."
"I do not know all the commandments."
"I am too poor to keep the Sabbaths."
questions.correctAnswer: "Teacher, all these I have kept from my youth."
questions.explanation: Mark 10:20 (ESV): "And he said to him, 'Teacher, all these I have kept from my youth.'"

questions.question: Jesus, looking at the rich man, loved him and said he lacked one thing. What was it?
options: "Go, sell all that you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me."
"Go and make sacrifices at the temple for your hidden sins."
"You must fast for forty days in the wilderness with me."
"You must leave your wife and children for the gospel."
questions.correctAnswer: "Go, sell all that you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me."
questions.explanation: Mark 10:21 (ESV): "And Jesus, looking at him, loved him, and said to him, 'You lack one thing: go, sell all that you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me.'"

questions.question: How harder is it for a rich person to enter the kingdom of God, according to Jesus?
options: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle
It is easier for a lion to eat grass like an ox
It is easier for a mountain to walk into the sea
It is easier for the sun to set in the east
questions.correctAnswer: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle
questions.explanation: Mark 10:25 (ESV): "It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to enter the kingdom of God."

questions.question: When the disciples were exceedingly astonished and asked "Then who can be saved?", what did Jesus reply?
options: "With man it is impossible, but not with God. For all things are possible with God."
"No one can be perfectly saved until the end."
"Those who give half of what they own."
"Only the simplest and poorest among you."
questions.correctAnswer: "With man it is impossible, but not with God. For all things are possible with God."
questions.explanation: Mark 10:27 (ESV): "Jesus looked at them and said, 'With man it is impossible, but not with God. For all things are possible with God.'"

questions.question: Jesus listed Peter, and everyone who has left houses, brothers, lands, etc., will receive a hundredfold now in this time, along with what?
options: Persecutions
Power to heal
A throne in heaven immediately
Safety from the Roman army
questions.explanation: Mark 10:30 (ESV): "who will not receive a hundredfold now in this time, houses and brothers and sisters and mothers and children and lands, with persecutions, and in the age to come eternal life."

questions.question: What did James and John, the sons of Zebedee, ask Jesus to do for them?
options: "Grant us to sit, one at your right hand and one at your left, in your glory."
"Grant us the power to call fire down from heaven."
"Make us the chief priests of the new temple."
"Give us the ability to forgive sins on our own."
questions.correctAnswer: "Grant us to sit, one at your right hand and one at your left, in your glory."
questions.explanation: Mark 10:37 (ESV): "And they said to him, 'Grant us to sit, one at your right hand and one at your left, in your glory.'"

questions.question: Jesus asked James and John if they were able to drink His cup or be baptized with the baptism with which He is baptized. What did they answer?
options: "We are able."
"We don't know."
"We are afraid, but willing."
"If you give us strength, yes."
questions.explanation: Mark 10:38-39 (ESV): "Jesus said to them, 'You do not know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink...' And they said to him, 'We are able.'"

questions.question: When the other ten disciples heard about James and John's request, they were indignant. Jesus called them and said, "Whoever would be great among you must be your..."?
options: Servant
Master
Teacher
Ruler
questions.explanation: Mark 10:43 (ESV): "But it shall not be so among you. But whoever would be great among you must be your servant,"

questions.question: Why did the Son of Man come, according to Mark 10:45?
options: "For even the Son of Man came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many."
"To overthrow the kingdom of darkness and rule Israel."
"To establish the church and correct the scribes."
"To show the love of the Father through miracles."
questions.correctAnswer: "For even the Son of Man came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many."
questions.explanation: Mark 10:45 (ESV): "For even the Son of Man came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many."

questions.question: As Jesus was leaving Jericho, a blind beggar was sitting by the roadside crying out, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!" What was his name?
options: Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, the son of Timaeus
Zacchaeus the short beggar
Malchus the servant
Simon the blind
questions.correctAnswer: Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, the son of Timaeus
questions.explanation: Mark 10:46 (ESV): "...Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, the son of Timaeus, was sitting by the roadside."

questions.question: When Jesus called the blind beggar over and asked, "What do you want me to do for you?", the man asked to recover his sight. What did Jesus say right before he was healed?
options: "Go your way; your faith has made you well."
"Your sins are forgiven, see again."
"I command the blindness to open."
"According to your crying out, let it be."
questions.correctAnswer: "Go your way; your faith has made you well."
questions.explanation: Mark 10:52 (ESV): "And Jesus said to him, 'Go your way; your faith has made you well.' And immediately he recovered his sight and followed him on the way."

key_verse_text: "For even the Son of Man came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many."
